data.one_liner: Flutter plugin to listen to incoming Android notifications and reply to them.
data.what_it_does: Allows Flutter applications to listen to incoming and removed notifications on Android via a stream. It also provides capabilities to read notification details (such as title, content, icons) and send direct replies.
use_when: You need to read incoming notifications from other apps on Android
You want to build an automation app that reacts to notifications
You need to send direct replies to notifications from Flutter
avoid_when: You only need to send local or push notifications for your own app
You are targeting iOS (plugin is focused on Android Notification Service)
strengths: Provides a stream of incoming and removed notifications
Supports sending direct replies to notifications
Exposes rich notification data including icons, images, and content
weaknesses: Android-specific platform limitations and configuration required
Requires manual user permission via system settings
data.setup_notes: Requires adding a service tag with BIND_NOTIFICATION_LISTENER_SERVICE permission inside the AndroidManifest.xml and requesting runtime permission from the user.

alternatives.name: flutter_local_notifications
alternatives.why_pick_it: Pick flutter_local_notifications if you primarily need to display local notifications rather than listening to system-wide notifications from other apps.
